newsitem.title: GREECE: KARAVITIS TO BE GREECE'S NEW STATISTICS CHIEF.
newsitem.headline: KARAVITIS TO BE GREECE'S NEW STATISTICS CHIEF.

text.p: Professor Nikos Karavitis will take over as General Secretary of Greece's National Statistics Service (NSS), replacing Fani Zervou, national economy ministry sources said on Wednesday.
Karavitis is an economics professor at Panteion University and is a member of Prime Minister Costas Simitis's council of economic advisors.
The sources said he would take up his post soon. --Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
